title: Extracellular vesicle long RNA markers of early-stage lung adenocarcinoma
description: The serum EV genes has great diagnostic value for lung adenocarcinoma patients with tumor size smaller than 2cm, which may serve as an important supplement to lung cancer screening. Overall design: Extracellular vesicle long RNA profiles of human serum by next generation sequencing
